lintIssues.message: Program must start with a standalone % line.
Program must end with a standalone % line.
G41/G42 while spindle is off — start spindle (M3/M4) before cutter compensation.
G41/G42 without D and no prior D offset active — set D explicitly or confirm carried offset state.
G41/G42 while tool length compensation (G43) is inactive — apply G43 before cutter compensation.
M30 while cutter compensation (G41/G42) is still active — cancel with G40 before program end.
Program ends with cutter compensation (G41/G42) still active — cancel with G40 before end.
